name: R (Friends of the Earth, ClientEarth, Good Law Project) v Secretary of State for BEIS – Net Zero Strategy
description: Two judicial review claims brought by ClientEarth, Friends of the Earth and Good Law Project against the Secretary of State for Business, Energy and Industrial Strategy for the inadequacy of the UK Net Zero Strategy (2021, later the Carbon Budget Delivery Plan 2023) under the Climate Change Act 2008. Cross-cutting impact on emissions and air quality (above all NOx and PM from transport and construction).
outcome: In July 2022 the High Court declared the Net Zero Strategy unlawful for lack of reasoning, in breach of s. 14 CCA 2008. In May 2024 the Court again declared the Carbon Budget Delivery Plan 2023 unlawful, holding the assessment of the likelihood of meeting the targets of the subsequent carbon budgets to be irrational. The Government was ordered to produce a new strategy within 12 months.
